C0044.title: Douyin Cracks Down on "Main–Alt Account" Matrix Cheating
C0044.summary: Douyin released its Matrix Account Misconduct Governance Rules, targeting group-control tools, illegal scripts, and other technical means used to operate multiple accounts for violative low-quality content, follower/like/comment inflation, and fabricated engagement data. The platform penalized multiple accounts or account matrices with over one million followers, removed violating MCN agencies, and cooperated with public security authorities in arresting 157 suspects.
